get.description: `status`, `image` (`Deployment:Image`, set by the compose deployer) and the server `version`.
200 once persisted state is loaded, 503 before.
The OIDC authority, client id and scopes the web UI and `pl login` use.
`status=active` (default): every waiting, scheduled or in-progress attempt across pipelines, oldest first. `status=waiting`: only the ones waiting for external input.

post.description: Runs the reconcile checks on a manifest (`pl dev validate`). Always 200, with `valid`, `manifestHash`, `errors` and `warnings`.
New runs start on `version`. `cancelRunning` cancels the other versions' runs and drains first. 409, with the reasons, when the config document or a secret it references doesn't satisfy that version.

post.summary: Create a pipeline bound to a repo
post.description: The only way to create a pipeline. The binding watches `path` (default `.pipelines`) on `branch` of `repo`; `credentialsSecret` names the pipeline-secret key holding a GitHub token.
Queues a reconcile of the bound config and returns at once; progress shows in the binding status. Also retries a failed commit.

patch.description: Sets or clears the credentials secret key.

put.summary: Turn the binding's polling on or off
put.description: Off, the binding no longer polls GitHub for config commits or branch heads; it syncs only on `POST …/binding/reconcile` or its webhook. For bindings driven from outside, such as a test fixture another pipeline reconciles and triggers.

put.summary: Move the binding to another branch
put.description: Binds the pipeline to another branch of the same repo, keeping its runs, versions and secrets. The next poll reconciles if that branch's newest config commit differs, and fires the push trigger if its head differs from the last push.

post.description: Receives the binding's GitHub push webhook. Anonymous, verified with the webhook's HMAC signature.

get.description: The last reconcile's result and commit, whether one is in progress, the resulting and the active version, problems and warnings.

post.description: A delivery for the pipeline's `onWebhook` trigger `trigger`. Anonymous, verified with the trigger's secret. Answers 202; the delivery is mapped to a run input in the background.

Another system answers a step's external input with `from: [callback()]`. The URL comes from `ctx.inputUrl(step, input)` and is the credential: anonymous, valid while the step waits for that input. The body is the value as JSON, or `{"$decline": "reason"}` to fail the step without running it. Answers 202.

get.description: Server-sent change notifications for one pipeline (`pipeline`) or all; see Live events above.
The attempt's log as server-sent events (`attempt`, default the latest): `log` events `{text, reset}`, then `end` `{status}` once the attempt is finished.

delete.description: Deletes the pipeline with its runs, versions, binding and secrets.

get.description: One card per pipeline for the list page: id, name, description, repo and health.

The secrets the active version (steps, failure handlers, poll triggers) or the binding uses, plus set but unused ones, each with `declaredBy` and `isSet` (null when Kubernetes can't be read). Values are never returned.

put.description: Sets the value. Re-checks a pending version.

delete.description: Deleting a secret the current config references needs `force=true` (409 without). Re-checks a pending version.

post.description: Copies values server-side from `sourcePipelineId` (`names`, default all; `targetName` renames a single one). Existing names are refused without `overwrite`. Answers the copied names. Whoever can write the target pipeline can read the copied values from its steps.

get.description: The YAML document as saved, and its snapshot (number, author, time, `restoredFrom`). `snapshot` gets an older one; `yaml` is empty before the first save.

put.description: Saves `yaml` as the next snapshot. 400 with each problem when the active version rejects it. The answer has the check against the active and the pending version, and the version it activated, if any.

get.description: Newest first.

post.description: Saves snapshot `snapshot`'s content again as the newest.

get.description: The current document against `version` (default: the pending version, else the active one): validity, whether it is satisfied, problems, referenced and missing secrets, changed defaults and the effective values.
Runs of the pipeline, newest first, paged.

post.description: Starts a manual run; the body is the pipeline input, validated against the input model. `outcome` is `started` or `queued` (during a draining switch).

get.summary: Get the critical path of a range of runs
get.description: Per run, each stage's critical step (the one that finished last) and its time; per step, how often it was on the path and its share of the total. `from` and `to` are run numbers (default: the latest 20 runs, at most 500); without `from`, `sinceVersion` starts at the first run on that pipeline version or a later one. Only succeeded runs unless `includeUnsuccessful`. A stage counts one pass of attempts: automatic retries are included, later reruns are not.
Input, pinned version, commit and config snapshot, links, whether it can be continued, and its stages with each step's status.

post.description: Cancels the run and its scheduled and in-progress attempts (their Jobs are deleted).
Starts a new run with the same input (`rerunOf` points back).
Continues the run with `input` merged over its stored input. Fields consumed by completed steps can't change; the run's version must be active.

get.summary: List a step's attempts in a run

post.description: A new attempt of the step on the run's pinned version and pool. With `continue`, the run goes on downstream afterwards.
Cancels the step's scheduled or in-progress attempt (its Job is deleted). The run ends Cancelled once the stage settles.

Gives the value of an external input of a step that waits for it (`name` may be omitted when the step has one). The value is validated against the input's model; once every external input is answered the step is scheduled.
Fails a step that waits for input without running it; the reason names who declined and the comment.

get.description: The files an attempt stored.
One stored file; a directory `dir/` downloads as `dir.tar`.
The output JSON of `attempt` (default: the latest successful attempt).
The attempt's log; the live pod log while it runs.
Run-based health: the last run, running and held runs, blocked steps and the activation.

post.description: Runs that reach the step are held there until it is unblocked. Answers the blocked step names.
Held runs resume. Answers the blocked step names.

get.description: The step's attempts across runs, with markers where the step's definition changed.
Every version (commit, step and model versions) and the current activation.
One version, including its canonical manifest.
The version with each `select` resolved by a config snapshot: the steps a run of it would have.
